I have noticed that a lot of people are under the impression that google gathers data about its users and then sells that to advertisers, etc. but this is not true. Google gathers data so that they can deliver targeted ads. Their customers provide them with ads and the demographic that they want to target and then google delivers the advertisement. If google sold the data themselves, it would be a relatively trivial matter for unscrupulous people to turn around and resell the data, thus removing googles ability to remain competitive (since the reseller only has to recoup the cost of buying the info while google has to recoup the cost of gathering the data). Google has a serious financial motive for keeping the data that they gather about you as private as possible. All they can sell is an opportunity to show an ad to someone matching a specific set of criteria. You can verify this for yourself. Google give free adwords credits to anyone who signs up, so you can easily become an advertiser and see what information is available to you to try.
